description: Shared Renovate settings for milo-os repositories. Go module updates open one pull request per repository, with Kubernetes modules in a pull request of their own. Security fixes keep Renovate's default of opening immediately and outside the concurrency limit.

packageRules.description: One pull request for all other Go module updates, so merging one does not rebase a queue of siblings
k8s.io/kubernetes only builds against staging modules of the same release, so bump it, every pinned staging module and controller-runtime together
